scripts.dev:https: sh -c 'CERT_DIR=$(cd .. && pwd)/.certs; NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="$CERT_DIR/jinxfamily-local.crt" exec next dev -p 3002 -H 0.0.0.0 --experimental-https --experimental-https-key "$CERT_DIR/jinxfamily-local.key" --experimental-https-cert "$CERT_DIR/jinxfamily-local.crt" "$@"' --
scripts.deploy: npm run build && pm2 restart jinxfamily-frontend
scripts.verify:public: npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run performance:budget && npm run test:browser
